summary: Round 1 at role base ef41f6521e178987dd349ac8a6854bd4a413333d (HEAD equalled that SHA at the start of the review, and no move was observed). Verdict: fail, with four Blockers and nine non-blocking findings. F1: app/[locale]/not-found.tsx is a server component with no route params, and the plan names no way to read the level, so the implementer must pick a client hook, a new segment boundary, or a header read. F2: the spec says the target week comes by loadVisibleWeek, but that function needs a week number and lib/content.ts holds no function that lists the open weeks of a level. F3: the shared 404 also serves an unknown locale, an unparsable path, an absent week, and the disabled teacher routes, and the plan gives no content for those paths. F4: the active label of the playing state is new English and Thai copy with no message key and no value, so no Red test can assert it. The track fixes eleven UI council findings in Phase 1 and ports Daniel's look pick in Phase 2.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] plan.md 1.1 / spec AC-1.1: The not-found page gets no route params, and the plan names no way to read the level. Rationale: app/[locale]/not-found.tsx is a server component, and __tests__/phase3-not-found.test.tsx:31 calls it with no arguments, so the implementer must choose a client hook, a new segment boundary, or a header read.

F2 [Blocker] plan.md 1.1 / spec AC-1.1: The spec says the target comes 'by loadVisibleWeek', but that function needs a week number. Rationale: lib/content.ts holds no function that lists the open weeks of a level, so the helper name, file, and scan cost stay open choices.

F3 [Blocker] plan.md 1.1 / spec AC-1.1-1.2: The shared 404 also serves an unknown locale, an unparsable path, an absent week, and the disabled teacher routes. Rationale: the plan does not say what the page shows on those paths, and 'the week is not open yet' is false on each of them.

F4 [Blocker] plan.md 1.5 / spec AC-1.6: 'An active label' is new English and Thai copy with no message key and no value. Rationale: a Red test cannot assert an exact label, and this copy is a Daniel check.
nonblocking_findings: F5 [Major] plan.md Phase 1: No task names its test file. Rationale: the repo keeps tests in apps/storytime/__tests__/phase3-*.test.tsx, so the implementer must pick a file for each Red test.

F6 [Major] plan.md 1.3 / spec AC-1.4: The planned Red test already passes. Rationale: song.tsx:122 sets poster, no hiding style exists, and phase3-song-ui.test.tsx:45-88 already asserts the poster; a video ignores poster during playback, so the test cannot prove the blank is gone.

F7 [Major] spec AC-1.9 / plan.md 1.8: The quoted sentence is page 2. Rationale: page 1 and the council finding 18 case are 'Hello, I am Pat.', and the AC names no page, so the test can assert the wrong page.

F8 [Major] plan.md 1.2 / spec AC-1.3: The plan changes the case but names no existing test to update. Rationale: phase3-adversarial-r2-pieces.test.tsx hard-codes the upper case at lines 68-70, 99, 115, and 127, so Green breaks them.

F9 [Major] plan.md 1.1 / spec AC-1.1: The new Thai 404 draft breaks an existing rule. Rationale: phase3-not-found.test.tsx:41-42 requires the Thai and English 404 values to be equal, and the plan names neither that test nor the rule.

F10 [Major] plan.md Phase 2 / spec §2: The route folder holds five files, and the list names four. Rationale: questions.tsx is the question screen inside the reader, and the plan leaves its look scope open.

F11 [Major] plan.md 1.7 / spec AC-1.8: The Red test needs a server, and no harness is named. Rationale: the app tests are jsdom unit tests, and the spec does not name the one 404 resource, so the failing URL is unknown.
F12 [Nit] spec §1 and metadata.json: 'eight council findings' is 11. Rationale: Phase 1 covers findings 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 18; the count does not change the build.
F13 [Nit] spec §2: 'the English label of item 6' is ambiguous. Rationale: the label is council finding 2, and council finding 6 is the page indicator.

paraphrase.proposes: Phase 1 fixes eleven UI council findings on the Storytime week pages. It replaces the 404 text with a week-not-open message and one button to the highest open week. It keeps the decodable case, shows a playing state, makes the reader turn pages together, changes the decodable label to 'Read the words', removes one 404 sub-resource, and evens the word gaps. Phase 2 ports the look of the option that Daniel picks.
paraphrase.current_system: Four route files under app/[locale]/st/[level]/[week]/ render the week home, the decodable, the reader, and the song. loadVisibleWeek gates a week, and the locale not-found.tsx renders a two-language 404. The decodable renders upper-case words and the reader turns pages instantly. The pages use a white background and grey-outline cards.
